modules.title: Getting Started
modules.content:
## Synergy Baseball: Minimum Requirements & Recommended Requirements

### Minimum Computer Specifications

Synergy Baseball App works equally well on PC or on MAC. Requirements include:

####

#### PC

- Windows 10
- Dual Core 2.0GHz processor or equivalent
- 4 GB RAM
- NVIDIA Ti 4800 or ATI 9800 graphics or equivalent
- 10 GB of free hard drive space
- 4.7.2 (x86 and x64) Microsoft .Net Framework

#### Mac

- macOS 12 Monterey or newer
- i5 At least 2.3GHz before Turbo Boost - 2013 and later
- 4 GB RAM
- HD Graphics 4000 GeForce GT 650M or equivalent
- 10 GB of free hard drive space

####

### Recommended Requirements

Synergy recommends the following specifications.

If you are purchasing a new Mac computer, a quad-core processor and a discrete graphics card are essential. For Windows, a multi-core processor is essential.

Increased RAM, at or greater than the recommended configuration below, and sufficient hard disk space or video backup storage, are the next most important options to consider for capture and editing workflows.

####

#### PC

- Windows 11
- Intel quad-core i5 processor or greater at least 2.3GHz before Turbo Boost
- 8 GB RAM or greater
- Discrete graphics card
- 512 GB of free hard drive space
- 4.7.2 (x86 and x64) Microsoft .Net Framework

#### Mac

- macOS 12 Monterey or newer
- i7 2.5 GHz processor
- 8 GB RAM
- Discrete graphics card
- 512 GB of free hard drive space or greater

> **Note**: Multi-core i3 devices that meet the requirements above will support basic playlist viewing and sharing but might experience performance downgrades with advanced capture and editing workflow.

#### Internet Bandwidth Requirements

For the smoothest video playback, it is recommended, though not required, that teams have 5-10 MBPS of upload and download bandwidth available on campus.

Because of the large size of game video files, we recommend upload speeds of 5+ Mbps to ensure games are uploaded in a timely fashion.

####

#### Required Video and File Formats

Teams must provide video files for every game unless the game is broadcast or a Synergy-captured live webstream.

- For games not captured by Synergy, the following formats can be uploaded to Synergy for breakdown: .MP4, .AVI, .WMV, .MOV, .MPG, .MOD, .MTS, .VOB.

Teams must provide Synergy with Roster, Box Score, and Pitch Charts including pitch type, location, and velocity.

- Synergy allows the following file types: .HTML, .XML, .CSV, .PDF, .PNG, .JPEG.

#### Documents Folder Setup

- Ensure Synergy files are written to the Documents folder on your computer’s hard drive (not to a networked drive with limitations).
- The Documents folder should be at least 25 GB of available disk space.
- You must also have Read/Write permissions on the specified Documents folder.

## Overview

The Synergy Baseball app delivers rich data filtering and video playback options to generate data with associated video for one or more teams, seasons, games, or players.

After you select your data for a player or team, you can use the app to:

- Visualize data in detailed pitch and spray charts which are printable as a PDF with additional filters;
- Review basic statistics;
- View the associated game film with side-by-side videos for multi-angle events;
- Generate multiple advanced reports to analyze and share;
- Save reports for further use, or;
- See the pitch-by-pitch details for specific games with more filtering options (Single Game view).

![Screenshot: Overview](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565361-01.jpg)

## How to Install the Baseball App

####

### How to Download the Baseball Application

To download the Baseball Application, click on the download link: <https://www.synergysportstech.com/baseballclient/>

Once you click on the link you'll follow the instructions below depending on the type of computer you use.

#####

#### For PC users:

1. Once you click on the download link, you should automatically see the following screen.
![Screenshot: How to Install the Baseball App](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565362-01.jpg)

2. Click the **Install**button. If prompted, Click **Run**

3. After installing, the program will open and prompt you to log in. Check the Remember me box to store credentials for future use

![Screenshot: How to Install the Baseball App](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565362-02.jpg)

####

#### For Mac users:

 1. Once you click on the download link, you should automatically see the following screen.

![Screenshot: How to Install the Baseball App](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565362-03.jpg)

2. Click the **Download**button.

3. Once downloaded, open the DMG file and drag the Synergy Baseball App icon into the Applications folder icon. This step is necessary to receive notifications for future updates to the Baseball Application.

4. From the Applications folder, open the Synergy Baseball App. If prompted, click **Open** for any message asking you to confirm that you want to open Synergy Baseball App.

## How To Log In

The Synergy Baseball app login page provides several security improvements for the storage of user credentials. When logging in to the Synergy Baseball app for the first time, follow the instructions below:

1. Ensure your preferred language is selected
2. Click the **Remember Me** box in the app to store credentials for future use
3. Select the **Click here to log in** button in the app to launch the web browser
4. Enter your username & password in the web browser, then select the **Login** button to automatically return back to the app. For future use, the app will automatically log in if **Remember me** has been selected

modules.title: Tools, Views and Event Types
modules.content:
## Tools and Views

The Synergy Baseball App has a variety of tools that are available in every view. Across the top of the application, you can access the following items in every view (from left to right):

![Screenshot: Tools and Views](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565364-01.jpg)

- Video playback: choose between in-app Player, Synergy Editor, or Compare for split screen.
- Add Report: this is only available after creating an initial report.
- Multigame View
- Reports View
- Single Game View
- Saved Reports
- Settings Menu (indicated by the three line hamburger icon)

![Screenshot: Tools and Views](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565364-02.jpg)

- - Settings
    - General: set the location for video cache folder, access application log files, and set pitch velocity measurement units.
![Screenshot: Tools and Views](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565364-03.jpg)
    - Video: set video quality to Low, Medium, or High.
![Screenshot: Tools and Views](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565364-04.jpg)
  - About: view details of your current version of the Baseball application.
![Screenshot: Tools and Views](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565364-05.jpg)
  - Help: contact our support agents with any questions or issues you may have through the Synergy Support page.
  - Video Guides: access our How-To Video Library for helpful instructions and tips.
  - Upload Schedule: quick access to the Baseball Portal to view your teams upload schedule.
  - Admin: quick access to the Baseball Portal for account management and upload schedule (only available for team admins).
  - Logout
  - Exit

The Filters menu, along the lefthand side, is always visible from any view with the exception of the Saved Reports view. However, available filters may change depending on the active view, previous inputs, or selections from other filters.

![Screenshot: Tools and Views](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565364-06.jpg)

## Event Types

The Event Type filter is now available in the Synergy Baseball application, allowing you to filter events based on type, including **Pitch**, **Pickoff**, **Balk**, **Challenge**, **Interruption of Play**, **Other**, or any combination of event types.

To set your filter, click **Event Types**, next to Data Source at the top of the filters list, and a dropdown will appear, allowing you to select whichever event types you would like to filter for. Once selected only your filtered event types will display.

![Screenshot: Event Types](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585700-01.jpg)

This filter applies to both the Multigame view, and the Reports view.

![Screenshot: Event Types](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585700-02.jpg)

When the Pickoff event filter has been selected, an additional**Pickoff Attempts** filter parameter is available at the bottom of the filters list, allowing you to further filter your pickoff event results.

Available filters include:

**Pitcher**:

Pickoff Attempts

Pickoff Outs

Pickoff Errors

**Catcher**:

Pickoff Attempts

Pickoff Outs

Pickoff Errors

![Screenshot: Event Types](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585700-03.jpg)

modules.title: Data and Chart Filters
modules.content:
## Using Data Filters

In the Synergy Baseball Application, filters are used to customize the data and video presented. The filters located on the left-hand side of the application, are dynamic and update your report as they are applied.

![Screenshot: Using Data Filters](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565365-01.jpg)

Some filters contain additional sub-filters to refine your search even further. The filters section can be collapsed or expanded by selecting the arrow to the right vertical gray filters bar.

For all data filters, after you select the filter you wish to use, you must click the **Apply** button to put the filter into place. You can select one or multiple values for each filter using the radio buttons or range slider (depending on the filter) to view additional options. Use the **Reset** option to clear the selections for an active filter.

### Using Data Filters in Different Views

The Synergy Baseball app defaults to the Multigame View. Here, you can compare a variety of filters across several games. If you would like to explore other views, simply select the desired view from the options at the top right.

![Screenshot: Using Data Filters](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565365-02.jpg)

Each view requires initial input to get started.

Select filters for **Pitcher**, **Hitter**, **Fielder**, **Baserunner**, and **Catcher** to act as primary filters for the data set you are trying to generate.

When making selections for these fields, select the parameters from the dropdown menu(s) or enter text to search for Teams/Players in Pitcher(s), Hitter(s), Fielder(s), Baserunner(s), Catcher(s).

![Screenshot: Using Data Filters](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565365-03.jpg)

If you start by selecting a pitcher, for example, you can then also select hitters who appeared against that pitcher, or, in the hitter filter, you can change the pitcher selection (and vice versa for all player filters) using the **Change** button in the top right of the filter details window.

![Screenshot: Using Data Filters](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565365-04.jpg)

After selecting initial player information in the data filters, your report will be generated, and the new **Team History** button will appear next to the player's name in the filter menu. The Team History button allows you to return to the player's Team History page to easily add or remove teams and seasons to your search results. This feature is available in both the Multigame and Report views.

###

### Resetting the filters

To reset all filters and to start a new report in the Multigame or Reports view, click **Reset All** in the top left-hand corner of the Filter Panel. If you would like to reset just one individual filter, but leave the remaining filters intact, open the filter you want to reset, and then click **Reset** on the top right-hand corner of the panel. After you click **Reset**, you must then click **Apply** to clear the specific filter.

![Screenshot: Using Data Filters](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565365-05.jpg)

## Using Chart Filters

For use with Multigame view, access the filters using the grey **Chart Filter** menu to the right of the Spray Chart.

Filter Options include:

Pitch Chart

- Type
- Zones
  - Total
  - Percentage
  - AVG
  - OBP
  - SLG
  - OPS
- Efficiency

![Screenshot: Using Chart Filters](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565367-01.jpg)

Spray Chart

- Type
- Zones
  - Total
  - Percentage

Visual Filters

- Pitcher
  - LHP
  - RHP
- Hitter
  - LHH
  - RHH
- Pitcher vs Hitter
  - LHP vs LHH
  - LHP vs RHH
  - RHP vs LHH
  - RHP vs RHH

Pitch

- Type
- Velocity
- Result
- Pitch # Sequence

BIP

- Type
- Result

Additionally, you can click and drag anywhere on the pitch chart to select multiple events from a specific area, or with the zones filter select multiple zones by clicking on the desired zones, and deselect a zone by clicking it a second time.

###

To reset all filters and to start a new report in the Multigame or Reports view, click **Reset Filters** in the top right-hand corner of the Filter Panel.

If you would like to reset just one individual filter, but leave the remaining filters intact, open the filter, and then click **Reset** on the top right-hand corner of the panel.

After you click **Reset**, you must then click **Apply** to clear the specific filter.

modules.title: Data Filter Definitions
modules.content:
The Synergy Baseball app currently provides the following player and game state data filters and sub-filters. Sub-filters will become available after the report has been created (for most primary filters):

**Pitcher(s):**Select or search from the list of pitchers that pitched in the original data set.

- Pitch Delivery
- Mound Position
- Leg Kick/ Slide Step
- Arm Release Angle

**Hitter(s):**Select or search from the list of hitters who batted in the original data set.

- Hands
- Stride
- Leg Kick
- Swing Type

**Left /Right:** Filter results to include only left-handed or right-handed pitchers, and/or left-handed or right-handed hitters.

**Fielder(s):** Select or search fielders from the list of fielders from the original data set. Note that the fielder in this filter is the first player to touch the ball after it was hit.

- Fielder Position
- Fielder Touch Order
- Previous Fielder
- Next Fielder
- Fielding Type
- Fielding Direction
- Fielding Extra Effort
- Throw Type
- Throw To Base
- Throw Accuracy

**Baserunner(s):**Select or search from the list of baserunners that were on base during the original data set.

- Start Location
- End Location

**Catcher(s):**Select or search from the list of catchers that received pitches in the original data set.

- Blocks
- Throws

**Camera Angle**:

- Displays each available Camera Angle from both single angle and multi-angle pitches.
- A drop-down menu with two different playback options.
  - All pitches with at least one selected angle.
    - Eg: Select Broadcast and Low Home, then all pitches with either angle would be displayed.
  - Only pitches including each selected angle.
    - Eg: Select Broadcast and Low Home, then only pitches including both angles would be displayed.
- For multi-angle pitches, selected option(s) display in right video window by default.
- As Logged clips display in left video window by default.
- Data available beginning in 2018 for Synergy logged games.

**Game(s):**Narrow the selection of games that are displayed in your reports and charts. By default, the data filters will show everything that has been logged for the initial player (or other selection). You can select one or multiple games to filter. Expand the subfilters by selecting the arrow to the right. Use the additional quick filters to select.

- Start Date
- End Date
- Previous # Games
- Previous # At Bats
- Day of the Week
- Game Type
- Conference(S)
- Division(s)

**Innings:** Narrow the data set to specific innings of play by

- Range*:* Toggle the bar to select which range of innings you would like to include.
  - You can also choose to manually type into designated boxes on the left and right.
  - Click **Add Range** to filter multiple inning ranges. For example, you can include innings 2-4 and 6-8.
  - To delete a range, you can click **Delete Range** and then select the red **X** on the right-hand side to clear.
- Grouped Innings*:* Select a specific group of innings from the pre-designated list. You can select one or multiple options from this panel.
- Individual Innings*:* Select a specific inning from this list. You can select one or multiple innings from this panel to include.
- Extra Innings*:* This panel is the same as individual innings, however, it separates the extra innings from the regular game-length innings.

- **Score:** Narrow the data set to plays where the score of the game is within the set range. You can select one or multiple filters to apply.

**Range**: Slide the bar to select which range of scores you would like to include. You can also choose to manually type into designated boxes on the left and right.

- Click **Add Range** to filter multiple score ranges. For example, you can include -5 to -1 and 1 to 6 to eliminate every play when the game is tied.
- If you would like to delete a range, you can click **Delete Range** and then select the red **X** on the right side to clear.

**Runners on Base:**Narrow the data set to scenarios in which there are runners on base. You can select one or multiple filters to apply.

**Outs:** Narrow the data set to scenarios in which there are a specific number of outs. You can select one or multiple filters to apply.

**Count:** Narrow the data set to scenarios with a specific pitch count. You can select one or multiple filters to apply.

**Pitch Type / Velocity:** Narrow the data set to specific pitch types, as well as to pitches with a specific velocity. You can select one or multiple filters to apply

- Pitch Velocity average column added to the right of each available Pitch Type.
- Pitch Velocity range now reflective of total velocity range based on search and filters.
- Click **Add Range** to filter multiple pitches. For example, you can include changeups that are above 85 MPH and fastballs above 90 MPH.
- If you would like to delete a range, you can click **Delete Range** and then select the red **X** on the right side to clear.

**Pitch Result:** Narrow the data set to plays in which the pitch resulted in a specific scenario, such as a ball, strike, ball in play, etc. You can select one or multiple filters to apply.

**Pitch Zones:** Narrow the data set to pitches in specific zones both inside and outside the strike zone.

> - Note: the innermost box represents the strike zone while the area between the boxes represents the one ball off zone, the equivalent to one baseball width outside of the strike zone.

You can select one or multiple filters to apply in addition to 4 group filters.

- **BIP Type:** Narrow the data set to plays in which the ball was put into play, and then further narrow it down to a specific type of ball in play. You can select one or multiple filters to apply.
- **BIP Result:**With this filter, you can narrow the data set to plays in which the ball was put into play, and then further narrow it down to a specific play result. You can select one or multiple filters to apply.
- **BIP Zones (Multigame & Reports views only):**A visual filter with 24 individual BIP Zones for balls in play. Click the desired area from the baseball field diagram:

### Areas include:

- Home Plate
- Infield Left Foul Line
- Infield Left
- Infield Center
- Infield Right
- Infield Right Foul Line
- Outfield Left Foul Line
- Outfield Left
- Outfield Left Center
- Outfield Center
- Outfield Right Center
- Outfield Right
- Outfield Right Foul Line
- Home Run Left Foul Line
- Home Run Left
- Home Run Left Center
- Home Run Center
- Home Run Right Center
- Home Run Right
- Home Run Right Foul Line
- Foul Infield Left
- Foul Infield Right
- Foul Outfield Left
- Foul Outfield Right

Also includes 8 BIP Zones groups for balls in play

- Infield Left Side
- Infield Right Side
- All Infield
- All Outfield Left
- All Outfield Center
- All Outfield Right
- All Outfield
- All Home Runs

**BIP Hardness:** Narrow the data set to at-bat result by distance or strength at which the ball is hit.

**Non-BIP Result:** Narrow the data set to at-bat result pitches in at-bats that did not end with a ball put in play. You can select one or multiple filters to apply.

**Baserunner Movement (Multigame & Reports views only)**: Use to filter Safe and Out options for baserunner movement

**Bunts:** Narrow the data set to pitches where a bunt attempt was made by the hitter, and then further narrow it down to what type of bunt attempt occurred, if the bunt was put into play and the trajectory of the bunt. You can select one or multiple filters to apply.

**Pitch # Sequence:** With this filter, you can narrow the data set to the specific number pitch within an at-bat. Additionally, there is an option within this filter to filter for all last pitches of an at-bat. You can select one or multiple filters to apply.

- **Pitch # Count:**Narrow the data set to a range of pitch numbers of a pitcher’s appearance. You can select one or multiple filters to apply.
  - Click **Add Range** to add an additional range of pitches.
- **Lineup Order:** With this filter, you can narrow the data set to pitches seen by hitters in a specific spot in the lineup. You can select one or multiple filters to apply.

**Hitter(s) Position:**Narrow the data set to pitches seen by hitters in playing a specific position at the time of the at-bat. You can select one or multiple filters to apply.

modules.title: Report Tab and Video Playback
modules.content:
## Report Tab Features

After you have generated a report in Multigame or Report view, a blue report tab is generated at the bottom of the app window.

![Screenshot: Report Tab Features](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565368-01.jpg)

By clicking on the carrot icon, you can view the features of the report tab:

- **Save**- save your report for future use. Saved reports can be found in the Saved Reports view in the top right of the app.
- **Save As** - allows you to name your report before saving.
- **Duplicate Tab** - this will create a duplicate report tab, allowing you to make modifications to one report, then toggle back and forth.
- **Duplicate Tab - Multiple** - this is a new feature and will be discussed in more detail below.
- **Add New Tab** - create a brand new tab to allow you to work on multiple reports simultaneously.
- **Undo Last** - this will undo the last filter applied from the filters list on the left off the app, to return to your previous report results.
- **Revert To Saved** - if working from a previously saved report, and filters have been applied, this will revert back to the originally saved report.
- **Rename Tab** - change the name of your report tab at any time.
- **Close Tab** - this will close the report tab, and prompt you to save any changes before closing the report.

### Duplicate Tab - Multiple

This new feature allows you to create duplicate tabs for multiple players at one time. This is a tool to create multiple reports within a roster for easy side-by-side comparison.

Select players you would like to compare by clicking the radio buttons next to their names, or select all by clicking the radio button next to the position title at the top of the chart. This will create separate report tabs for each player selected and include all seasons played. To refine your results, click the carrot icon next to each player's name, allowing you to view only the seasons desired for each player.

Once your selections have been made, click **Apply** to generate the reports.

![Screenshot: Report Tab Features](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565368-02.jpg)

Once applied, the new report tabs will be listed at the bottom of the app window.

![Screenshot: Report Tab Features](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565368-03.jpg)

## Video Playback

Video playback is an essential and dynamic part of the Synergy Baseball App. Not only can you use the app to watch film, but you can also send desired clips and games to the Synergy Editor for use in your own custom edits and playlists that can be shared with your entire team.

### Playback Options

From the app's menu selections, either send the video to the in-app player by selecting **Playback**, send the clips to the Synergy **Editor**, or select **Compare** to view clips side by side with the in-app player.

![Screenshot: Video Playback](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565369-01.jpg)

**Playback:** This is the default setting and uses the Baseball Application's built-in video player.  When viewing clips in Playback mode, you can also send playlists to the Synergy Editor. This is done from the player window.

**Editor:** Send playlists directly to the Synergy Editor, where you can create Custom Edits, trim clips, and review video.

**Compare:**View playlists using the in-app players split screen mode which allows you to compare two separate plays simultaneously, or view multiple angles, when available, of a single play simultaneously.

In the Synergy Baseball app, to set your preference, make a selection from the top left of any view. The app will remember your setting until you manually change it again.

In order to play the video click the play icon button.

###

### Video Player

The video player in the Synergy Baseball app has been redesigned to provide an even better user experience. The video player utilizes a Multi-Angle Layout, allowing you to view multiple camera angles of the same plays at the same time.  With the dark theme, you can view comfortably in any environment and watch multi-angle events side by side.

![Screenshot: Video Playback](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565369-02.jpg)

#### Video Player Controls

The in-app video player contains a variety of controls to make the most of your experience. Controls currently available are (from top left to bottom right):

**Return Arrow**: In the upper left, clicking on it returns you to the Synergy Baseball app from the in-app player.

**Full AB**: click to expand the full At-Bat data associated with the current clip or set of clips. Click again to return to the playlist view.

![Screenshot: Video Playback](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565369-03.jpg)

**Playlist/Event View**: Toggle the selected clips as a list view or see them charted.

![Screenshot: Video Playback](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565369-04.jpg)
![Screenshot: Video Playback](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565369-05.jpg)

**Display Pickoff Attempts:**show pickoff attempts within the playlist view

![Screenshot: Video Playback](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565369-06.jpg)

**Clip** **Duration**: use dropdown to choose between **Standard** - the point from which the ball leaves the pitcher’s hand until it is returned to him or the play has concluded or **Extended***-*play back all available video between pitches.

**Pre Roll or Pitch Release Time**: set the time in the clip prior to the release of the pitch using the dropdown menu. Default is 3 sec.

**Multi-Angle** **View**: located to the left of the camera icon, is used to view the multi-angle video of a clip (when available)

**Camera Angle Names**

- The top bar above video player
  - Camera Angle menu
  - Send to Editor
  - Pop-out window
  - Fullscreen

**Detailed Pitch Info**

- The bottom bar below the video player
- Includes Pitch Type and Pitch Velocity when available

**Player Controls**: video player controls -

- Play/Pause
- Jump to Beginning of Clip
- Previous Clip
- Back One Frame
- Playhead Scrubber
- Forward One Frame
- Next Clip
- Jump to End of Clip
- Send Clips to Editor
- Full Screen

**Side-by-Side View**: Choose between **Player** to view the standard single screen video, or switch to **Compare** to view video side-by-side. For a more in-depth look at this exciting new feature, check out the Baseball Application: Compare Video (see the “Compare Video and Sending Clips” lesson) article.

![Screenshot: Video Playback](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565369-07.jpg)

modules.title: Compare Video and Sending Clips
modules.content:
## Compare Video : Getting started with Side-By-Side Playlists

The Compare Video tool allows you to filter down to specific game events and corresponding videos, then view the videos as a side-by-side playlist to compare and contrast the different events.

### Creating a Side-By-Side Playlist

First, you will need to drill down to the data that you want, using the search filters on the left. After filters have been applied, there are two separate ways to start a side-by-side playlist:

1. Switch the video option to  **Compare**and select "Send to Side-by-Side - Both" from the dropdown menu. Then click the play button.

> *Note: You will have to be on the Multigame View to see the play button. Mutigame View is the default view in the Synergy Baseball Application*

2. Click the play button. This will take you to a list-view of the selected clips. From here you will click on **Compare**, on the bottom right.

The side-by-side playlist will open in the Video Player. Jump to the Baseball Application: Compare Video – Video Player (see the “Compare Video and Sending Clips” lesson) article to learn how to manage the side-by-side playlist within the Video Player.

![Screenshot: Compare Video : Getting started with Side-By-Side Playlists](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565371-01.jpg)

## Compare Video: Video Player

### **Compare Mode in Video Player**

Once you've sent your side-by-side playlist to the video player, the video player will automatically open in Compare Mode. Select video clips from each playlist to view the videos. You have a variety of options to control the videos that you select.

Use play controls under each video player to change location in a video clip, or use the universal play controls at the bottom to change location in both video players simultaneously.

![Screenshot: Compare Video: Video Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565372-01.jpg)

The slider allows you to quickly change location within clips.

![Screenshot: Compare Video: Video Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565372-02.jpg)

The frame-by-frame controls allow you to go through clips one frame at a time.

![Screenshot: Compare Video: Video Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565372-03.jpg)

The skip controls will take you to the beginning or end of a clip.

![Screenshot: Compare Video: Video Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565372-04.jpg)

Change camera angle or adjust video duration above each video player.

Use the **Set**button to mark the sync point for each video player. Drag the sync point to move location in video clip and click  **Set**  again to remove the sync point. If you'd like to jump to the sync point in each video play you can click **Go To**.

If you'd like to collapse or expand playlists you can do so by clicking the arrow above the respective playlist.

You have the option to send clips from the video player to Synergy Editor, using the download buttons. The buttons above the playlists will send clips from the respective window. The download button at the bottom right will send clips from the left window, as a default.

![Screenshot: Compare Video: Video Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565372-05.jpg)

Additional options to customize your playlist name and preferences are available:

- Rename playlist titles by clicking the **Edit**buttons above each playlist table.
- Use the settings gear icon in the bottom right contains options when switching video clips in each playlist.
  - Autoplay begins playing video automatically.
  - Lock Time maintains the same time in scrubber.

The Video Player also has a video overlay feature. Video overlay places one video clip on top of another, so that users can compare and contrast different game events. Navigate to the [**Baseball Application: Compare Video – Video Overlay**](https://support.synergysports.com/hc/en-us/articles/12724415591309) article to learn more about this feature.

## Compare Video: Video Overlay

### Video Overlay

To get started with video overlay, you should already be in the video player. Select one clip from each side of the side-by-side playlist and then click **Overlay**, located under the playlist to the right.

Additional controls will appear under the playlists to help manage video overlay, and you have the option to manage video overlay in full screen mode.

Use the **Left**and **Right** controls to select which window you will be modifying. The arrows on your keyboard can be used to adjust the window you have selected.

> Note: If you have either **Left** or **Right**selected, you will not be able to use your keyboard to view the clips frame-by-frame. You will need to deselect the controls to get this option back, or use the frame-by-frame controls in the video player.

The magnifying glasses will increase or decrease the size of the window you have selected.

Use the **Change Video Opacity**tool to make a clip more or less transparent.

## Sending Clips to the Synergy Editor

Sending video from the Baseball Application to the Editor allows you to create custom edits, unique video playlists that you create, that can be shared with staff members and players. You can create Custom Edits using clips from the Synergy Baseball app, or from your own locally captured film.

Explore the information below to learn more about sending clips from the Baseball Application so you can use them to create custom edits.

### Sending Clips to the Editor

To begin the process of creating custom edits, you will need to send clips from the Synergy Baseball app to the Editor, or import your own film via the Live Capture process (see the section onLive Capture (see the “Live Capture and Streaming” lesson in Synergy Editor) for more detail).

To do this, ensure that you have **Editor**selected as the video choice in the Baseball app and make your selections either Standard or Extended, and set the lead duration anywhere from 0 to 10 seconds.

![Screenshot: Sending Clips to the Synergy Editor](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565375-01.jpg)

Use the filters to narrow down the video you would like to use in your Custom Edit. In Multigame view, once you have data you would like to send to the Synergy Editor, use the **Play arrow** icon above the chart to send the clips to the Editor.

![Screenshot: Sending Clips to the Synergy Editor](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565375-02.jpg)

In Single Game View, choose to send the full game to the Editor using the centrally located **Play** button, or select individual clips to send from a variety of displays using the **Play** button next to it.

![Screenshot: Sending Clips to the Synergy Editor](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565375-03.jpg)

In Report View, you can simply select any box containing a number associated with a particular filter, topic, or statistic.  This will automatically send those clips to the Editor and create a temporary playlist containing the clips.

![Screenshot: Sending Clips to the Synergy Editor](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565375-04.jpg)

Once you have sent your clips to the Editor, a temporary playlist is created in the bottom panel of the Editor. Use the carrot icon on the playlist tab at the bottom to save, export, or close this playlist. or move the clips into existing edit by dragging and dropping the clips.

![Screenshot: Sending Clips to the Synergy Editor](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565375-05.jpg)

modules.title: Single Game View
modules.content:
Single Game View generates a detailed report of your filtered data from a specific game. It allows you to explore in detail individual games from throughout the season using robust filters, easy-to-use navigation, and essential tools to create informative, rich reports.

## Getting Started

Access Single Game View by selecting the icon from the **View**menu in the upper right.

![Screenshot: Single Game View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565377-01.jpg)

To get started, select a League, Season, and Team. You may also enter an opponent and select a game from a specific matchup, however, this field is not required. If you do not select an opponent, a list of all games for the selected season will populate and you can select a game from the list.

![Screenshot: Single Game View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565377-02.jpg)

## Using the Report

The Single Game View report contains a variety of details and data.  When getting started with your report, be sure to make your video playback choice from the top left of the application window. Choose to view clips either in the In-App Player by selecting **Player**, **Editor**, which will send selected clips to the Synergy Editor application, or **Compare**, which will allow you to view clips side-by-side in the In-App Player for comparison. For a more in-depth look at the exciting new Compare feature, check out the Baseball Application: Compare Video (see the “Compare Video and Sending Clips” lesson) article. Whichever you choose, your video setting will remain the same for the session in all views until you change it.

![Screenshot: Single Game View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565377-03.jpg)

Located at the top left of the report are the details of the selected game, including the team names and date played. On the far left of the app window is an arrow icon that provides quick access to the collapsible **Find Game** menu. From here, you can quickly change any of the filters previously set, or select a new game.

![Screenshot: Single Game View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565377-04.jpg)

To the right is the **Line Score**. Here, each inning and the runs scored in that inning are displayed and used to navigate easily through your report data. Click one or multiple boxes to view the associated data. When selected, the box icon will be displayed as a light blue color, and the At-Bat data for that inning will be represented below on the charts and tables. To view all of the At-Bats for a team, select the radio button to the far right of the Line Score.

![Screenshot: Single Game View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565377-05.jpg)

Continuing on to the next section, we can see the **Strike Zone** chart. This is where the pitch locations from the currently selected at-bat are visualized. This view defaults to the pitcher’s perspective but can be switched to the catcher’s perspective by using the **Catcher’s View** tab below the strike zone chart.

![Screenshot: Single Game View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565377-06.jpg)

To view the full game video, click the **Play** icon button below the Line Score. Choose to Display/Hide Pickoff Attempts using the associated radio button, as well as change the data view using the icons to the right. The At-Bat Summary is selected by default, but choose from Pitch List, Pitch Detail, or Sequential views as well. Click on any line in the report table to view the associated data, or click the **Play** button to view the clip in the In-App player, or send it to the Synergy Editor depending on the video selection you made at the top left of the application window.

Customize the report further with the **Player/Innings** filters. Select the arrow on the right side of the app window to expand the filters. Choose from either View by Player or View by Inning at the top and make your selections.

At the bottom right of the app is a sequence of At-Bat displays for all at-bats that occurred during the inning(s) selected on the Line Score (all innings in light blue). You can select a specific at-bat by clicking the associated display, or scroll left or right using the arrow icons located at the bottom right corner.

![Screenshot: Single Game View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565377-07.jpg)

modules.title: Multigame View
modules.content:
## Multigame View: Overview

Multigame view provides rich visual displays for pitch locations and BIP results, as well as basic statistics, based on the data filters you apply.

The Multigame view is the first navigation icon in the top right of the application, and the default view for the Synergy Baseball App. You can hover over the icons with the mouse to see each icon label.

![Screenshot: Multigame View: Overview](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565378-01.jpg)

Use the filters on the left to select the player and season you would like to view and click **Apply**. Once finished, your report will generate and you will be able to view the information in both the chart and table views. You can play back video, customize the displays, rename, add notes, print to PDF, or save these displays and reports.

## Multigame View: Basic Statistics and Data Tables

Multigame view, in addition to the pitch and spray charts, provides six tables with pitch totals and percent calculations, based on the data filters you have applied:

- Basic Statistics
- Pitch Type
- Pitch Result
- BIP Type
- BIP Result
- Non-BIP Result

You can play back video for any row, including the overall rows of each table by selecting the row, and the clicking the **Play** icon above the display charts.

You can also expand or collapse each table individually.

## Multigame View: Multigame Displays Customization

The following tools are available to customize the view:

- To resize the controls, use the **+** and **-** icons immediately below the pitch chart.
- You can also display or hide the legend and your applied filter selections.

![Screenshot: Multigame View: Multigame Displays Customization](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565380-01.jpg)

To show only the pitch chart or only the spray chart, click the corresponding icon above the displays, to the right of the pitch count and playback icon.

![Screenshot: Multigame View: Multigame Displays Customization](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565380-02.jpg)

To change the title of the multigame report and add notes, click the drop-down arrow next to the chart display options (see above), and then click **Edit Display**.

To learn more information on how to use the Chart Filters in the Multigame view, check out the Baseball Application: Chart Filters (see the “Multigame View” lesson) article.

## Multigame View: Charts and Filters

By default, you will see two charts, a pitch chart, and a spray chart, followed by a set of expanding and collapsing tables with commonly used statistics.

#### Pitch Chart

By default, this is the leftmost chart. The Pitch Chart displays all pitch types that were thrown, grouped by type. Each color corresponds to a specific pitch type.

You can display or hide the legend below the chart to see detailed information, or you can use the visual filters to view pitches by efficiency scale or zone placement instead.

####

#### Spray Chart

By default, this is the rightmost chart. The Spray Chart displays all contact from the listed pitchers.

As with the pitches, each colored line corresponds to a specific hit type. You can display (or hide) the legend below the chart to see detailed information.

####

#### Chart Filters

The chart filters are located to the right of the Spray Chart.  Click the arrow in the grey bar to expand or collapse these filters. Use the arrow to the left of the filter name to expand each option further. These filters do not change the data filters you have applied using the left panel options of the view, such as player and game state.

The current filters available are:

**Display Settings**

Pitch Chart: These in-view filters allow you to choose how to display pitch data in the chart.

- Type
- Zones
- Efficiency

![Screenshot: Multigame View: Charts and Filters](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565382-01.jpg)

Spray Chart: These in-view filters allow you to choose how to display spray data in the chart.

- Type
- Zones

**Visual Filters**

Left / Right

- Pitcher
- Hitter
- Pitcher vs. Hitter

Pitch

- Type
- Velocity (MPH)
- Result
- Pitch # Sequence

BIP

- Type
- Result

## Multigame View: Video Playback for Multigame Displays and Reports

Playing clips from Multigame view works the same way as with the other views. In the upper left of the corner of the app, select your video playback option, **Player**, **Editor**, or **Compare**. **Player** will play video in the In-App player, **Editor** will send your selected clips to the Synergy Editor, and **Compare**will allow you to view video side-by-side in the In-App player. For a more in-depth look at the exciting new Compare feature, check out the Baseball Application: Compare Video (see the “Compare Video and Sending Clips” lesson) article.

![Screenshot: Multigame View: Video Playback for Multigame Displays and Reports](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565383-01.jpg)

Once you've chosen a playback option, select the clips you wish to view. To play all pitches or events, click the blue playback icon next to the display title and pitch count, above the display.

To play a single pitch or event only, click the pitch or spray chart line, and then click the **Play**icon.

To play video for a selection of pitches, contact results or pitch zones, either press CTRL while you click the ones you want to review, or click and drag over an area of the chart  to quickly select multiple pitches. Then click the **Play** icon above the chart.

To play a selection of video for any report below the displays, except the Basic Statistics table, click on the row of interest in the table or click the Overall row to play all video for that specific table.

> Note: AVG, OBP, SLG, and OPS percentages in the Basic Statistics table will not play video when selected. These percentages can be viewed by applying chart filters with the grey bar on the right of the spray chart. To learn more about chart filters, check out theBaseball Application: Chart Filters (see the “Data and Chart Filters” lesson) article.

## Multigame View: Duplicating or Deleting Reports

To find these options, use the drop-down menu option next to the icons above the chart display. From this drop-down menu, you can choose which charts to view, edit your display chart, duplicate the report for side-by-side comparisons, or delete a report.

## Multigame View: Save as PDF

To save a report as a PDF, use the menu with the PDF icon, above the chart display, directly next to the options to change, duplicate, or delete charts.

You can Save as PDF using one of 4 selections to print or distribute to your team:

- With Data: Includes images with data tables in portrait format.
- No Data: Includes images only in landscape format.
- All - With Data: Includes all duplicated images and data in landscape format.
- All - No Data: Includes all duplicated images only in a landscape format.

![Screenshot: Multigame View: Save as PDF](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565388-01.jpg)

Once you've made a selection, you will be prompted to name your report and chose a save location on your device.

![Screenshot: Multigame View: Save as PDF](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565388-02.jpg)

modules.title: Reports View
modules.content:
## Reports View: Overview and Getting Started

Reports View allows you to visualize statistical reports designed to easily display the most frequent user-viewed data. To access, click the **Reports View**icon in the upper right. Hover with the mouse to see each icon label as well.

![Screenshot: Reports View: Overview and Getting Started](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565389-01.jpg)

###

### Getting Started

To create a report, select a league, season, and team. For an individual player report, select a pitcher, hitter, fielder, baserunner, or catcher, using the filter selection on the right. Additionally, you can search for a player by name after filtering for player type.

The default report type is Basic Statistics. Use the report drop-down menu in the upper right of the application to change report types.  Choose from:

- Basic Statistics
- Left/Right Splits
- Matchups (Count)
- Pitch Types (Pitch Result)
- Pitch Type (BIP Result)
- Synergy Pitcher Attributes
- Synergy Hitter Attributes
- Pickoffs
- Stolen Bases
- Fielding
- Throwing

>  Note: The grey-to-blue scale of colors represents efficiency, ranging from low (grey) to high (blue). Report cells are color-coded by this efficiency scale.

## Reports View: Player Filters

It is important to note that player-type filters are going to display different data sets for each report. Some player-type filters are more useful than others for certain reports.

Below is a breakdown of the types of data displayed with each player type filter, which you select by expanding the slide-out panel on the left side of the app:

- Pitcher(s)- This filter will show every pitch that the pitcher has thrown for that team over the filtered time frame.
- Hitter(s)- This filter will show every pitch that the hitter has seen for that team over the filtered time frame.
- Fielder(s) - This filter will show every fielding play that fielder has been involved in for that team over the filtered time frame.
- Baserunner(s)- This filter will show every pitch that baserunner was on base for that team over the filtered time frame.
- Catcher(s)- This filter will show every pitch that the catcher has received for that team over the filtered time frame.

## Reports View: Playing Video

To play video in a report, select any cell of a report that displays either a number or a percentage.

> Note: AVG, OBP, SLG, and OPS percentages in the Basic Statistics reports will not play video when selected. These percentages are to provide stats based on Synergy’s data. To view these, use the Chart Filters in the Multigame view. For more information on how to do this, check out the Baseball Application: Chart Filters (see the “Data and Chart Filters” lesson) article.

To change how you play video for a report or any other view in the Synergy Baseball application, use the video playback options in the upper left of any view type.

![Screenshot: Reports View: Playing Video](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565393-01.jpg)

## Saved Reports

Reports represent information and data that is important, relevant, and necessary to making the best decisions, improving play and coaching, and exploring a variety of other aspects of the game. Once you've created the report, if you don't want to lose that work, and you want to be able to access it for future use, use the Save Report feature to store the report in your Saved Reports View.

After filtering for a set of data, save your report for future use by selecting the carrot icon in the active tab located below the report. You will have the option to save in both the Reports and Multigame View.

![Screenshot: Saved Reports](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565396-01.jpg)

From here, you can use the **Save** or **Save As** option to save the filtered data.

![Screenshot: Saved Reports](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565396-02.jpg)

To open a saved report, navigate to the **Saved Reports**View and select the radio button next to the desired report, then click **Load**.

![Screenshot: Saved Reports](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565396-03.jpg)

If you would like to delete a saved report, you must first click the radio button next to **Delete** from the top right above the list, then click the **X**icons next to the items you would like to delete.

![Screenshot: Saved Reports](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565396-04.jpg)

modules.title: Report Types
modules.content:
### Basic Statistics Report

This is the default report for this view. It is a display of six data tables featuring the most commonly used baseball statistics.

![Screenshot: Reports View: Report Types](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565390-01.jpg)

The data tables displayed in this view match what is displayed in the Multigame data tables which appear under the pitch and spray charts in that view. Both views provide:

· Basic statistics

· Pitch Type

· Pitch Result

· BIP Type

· BIP Result

· Non-BIP Result

> Note: AVG, OBP, SLG, and OPS percentages in the Basic Statistics reports will not play video when selected. These percentages are to provide stats based on Synergy’s data. To view these, use the Chart Filters in the Multigame view. For more information on how to do this, check out the [Baseball Application: Chart Filters](https://support.synergysports.com/hc/en-us/articles/360060747451-Baseball-Application-Chart-Filters) article.

### Left/Right Splits Report

This report details the number of pitches thrown or seen in different at-bat pitch counts broken down even further by hitter/pitcher handedness.

This report can be viewed by using the **Grouped Counts** tab or the **All Counts** tab in the upper left of the report.

Percentages are calculated by dividing the number in a row by the number in the Overall row in the same column.

![Screenshot: Reports View: Report Types](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565390-02.jpg)

By clicking the carrot icon to the left side of the row name, you can expand the report to see a breakdown of pitch types in each specific situation.

Percentages are calculated by dividing the number in a pitch type row by the number in the hitter/pitcher handedness row in the same column (RHP in the example below).

You can further expand the report by clicking on the individual pitch types. This will provide a breakdown of the pitch results for each pitch type.

Percentages are calculated by dividing the number in a pitch result row by the number in the pitch type row in the same column.

### Matchups Report *(Counts)*

This report details the number of pitches thrown or seen in different at-bat pitch counts. At the top of this report, you will find the filtered player's data against all hitters/pitchers. Below that will be the filtered player's data against individual hitters/pitchers. Expand a row by clicking the carrot icon to the left of the row name to view the pitch types thrown/seen in various counts.

![Screenshot: Reports View: Report Types](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565390-03.jpg)

> Note: The percentages displayed represent that column's pitch total divided by the pitch total in the **All** column.

### Pitch Types (Pitch Result)

This report displays pitch results as compared to the pitch type that the pitcher threw, or the hitter faced, based on the data filters you have applied using the left slide-out panel of the application.

When you click and expand any row title, the report displays both In-Zone and Out-Of-Zone pitches in addition to batting average, slugging percentage, and batting average on balls in play breakdown. You can switch between these by clicking on the greyed-out term you would like to view.

![Screenshot: Reports View: Report Types](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565390-04.jpg)

Expanding a row of the report and filter further by selecting the options in the sub-row titles:

- **In-Zone**: (default) or “Out-Of-Zone”
- **AVG**: (default), “SLG” or “BABIP” tabs

> Note: The row containing the AVG, SLG and BABIP percentages will not play video when selected. You must select the number above the percentage, in the In-Zone/Out-of-Zone row, or in the row containing total counts for that section of the report to play video for those events.

### Pitch Types (BIP Result)

This report breaks down BIP results and trajectory when facing or throwing certain pitch types based on the data filters you have applied using the left slide-out panel of the application.

When you click and expand any row title, the report displays both In-Zone and Out-Of-Zone pitches in addition batting average, slugging percentage, and batting average on balls in play breakdown.

![Screenshot: Reports View: Report Types](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565390-05.jpg)

Expanding a row of the report and filter further by selecting the options in the sub-row titles:

- **In-Zone**: (default) or Out-Of-Zone
- **AVG**: (default), SLG or BABIP tabs

> Note: The row containing the AVG, SLG and BABIP percentages will not play video when selected. You must select the number above the percentage, in the In-Zone/Out-of-Zone row, or in the row containing total counts for that section of the report to play video for those events.

### Synergy Pitcher Attributes Report *(Pitching - Result & Type Report)*

This report displays the pitcher attributes that Synergy tracks in professional baseball leagues. Use the tabs at the top of the report to filter for various pitch results and ball in play trajectories. To see the breakdown of the pitcher attributes, click each row title or carrot icon to expand the report. Percentages are calculated by dividing the number in a column by the number in the All Pitches column in the same row.

![Screenshot: Reports View: Report Types](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565390-06.jpg)

### Synergy Hitter Attributes Report *(Hitting - BIP Type & Quality Report)*

This report displays hitter attributes that Synergy tracks in professional baseball leagues. Unlike the Pitching – Result & Type report, this report will only include balls in play.

Use the tabs at the top of the report to filter by the ball in play trajectories. To see the breakdown of the hitter attributes, click each row title (or the expand/collapse icon to the left of each row title) to expand the report. Percentages are calculated by dividing the number in a column by the number in the **All BIP** column in the same row.

![Screenshot: Reports View: Report Types](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565390-07.jpg)

### Pickoffs

This report details when and where pickoffs occur for the filtered player. Use this report to see the counts and outs when the filtered player attempted pickoffs and bases where the filtered player has attempted pickoffs. It is important to note that successful pickoffs will be listed in the Pickoffs row. Percentages are calculated by dividing the number in a column by the number in the Total column in the same row.

![Screenshot: Reports View: Report Types](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565390-08.jpg)

### Stolen Bases

This report details situations and results of stolen base attempts by a baserunner. You can also use this report to view stolen base attempts against pitchers and catchers. Use the tabs above the report to filter for different at-bat pitch counts. Percentages in this report are calculated by taking the number in a column and dividing it by the SB Attempts column.

![Screenshot: Reports View: Report Types](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565390-09.jpg)

### Fielding

This report details all fielding plays that a fielder was involved in based on the data filters you have applied using the grey filter panel to the left in the app.

Synergy logs several fielding data points including:

- Type of fielding play
- The direction the fielder was moving
- Any extra effort by the fielder.

This report displays Fielding Touches for BIP Types with Synergy Proprietary data for Fielding Type, Fielding Direction, and Fielding Extra Effort.  It also includes views for Ground Ball, Line Drive, Fly Ball, Flare, Pop Up, Bunt, as well as Totals for All Touches as well as specific BIP Out and BIP Safe events.

To see all fielding data in the report click each row title to expand the report. Use the tabs above the report to filter for different BIP trajectories. Percentages are calculated by dividing the number in a column by the number in the Total Touches column.

![Screenshot: Reports View: Report Types](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565390-10.jpg)

After you expand a row by clicking the row title, click the sub-row titles to see a more detailed breakdown of the fielding by BIP quality, for example, under Fielding Type Standard, you can see:

- Hard Hit
- Soft Hit
- Very Hard Hit
- Medium Hit
- Very Soft Hit

## Throwing

This report details fielder throwing events based on the data filters you have applied using the filters panel to the left in the app.

Synergy logs several throwing data points including:

- The fielder threw a runner out, the throw type
- Position thrown to
- Cutoff throws
- Throw accuracy

This report displays all Fielder Throws for Balls In Play with Synergy Proprietary data for Throw Type, Throw From Position, and Throw Accuracy. Additionally, this includes Throws for BIP Type and All Fly Balls events, Totals for All Throws as well as To 1st Base, To 2nd Base, To 3rd Base, and To Home.

To see all throwing data in the report, click each row title to expand the report. Use the tabs above the report to filter for different BIP results. Percentages are calculated by dividing the number in a column by the number in the All Throws column.

![Screenshot: Reports View: Report Types](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565390-11.jpg)

By clicking on the rows containing the throwing tags, you can see an additional breakdown of the report by BIP trajectory.

After you expand a row by clicking the row title, click any sub-row titles to see a more detailed breakdown of the Throwing report. For example, under Throw Type, Standard, you can see:

- Ground Ball
- All Fly Balls
- All Bunts

If you click All Fly Balls, then you can see:

- Line Drive
- FlyBall + Flare (total
- Fly Ball
- Flare
- Pop Up

modules.title: Practice Views
modules.content:
## Practice View

The all new Practice view is located in the top right of the Baseball App, between the Reports view and the Single Game view. This tab allows you to retrieve practice footage and it's associated data that your team has captured using the Synergy Team Logger. You practice data is only viewable by members of your team.

#### Getting Started

When you open the Practice view, all of your uploaded practice data from the Synergy Team Logger will be displayed, grouped by practice session type, in tables. The practice session types are:

- **Sim Games**
- **Batting Practice**
- **Bullpen**
- **Training/Workout**

In the top left of the Practice view, you have the ability to search the your practice sessions by Player or Team using the search bar. Additionally, you can filter your practice sessions by League, Season, Team, and Player, using the dropdown menus. Only practice sessions including your search and filter results will display. To clear your search or session filters, click the **Clear** button.

![Screenshot: Practice View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565376-01.jpg)

You can also sort all table columns by clicking on the header, and reversing the order by clicking a second time.

To quickly view all video clips associated with a practice, you can simply click the play icon next to the practice session you would like to view.

For a comprehensive view of the data logged during your practice session, select the desired session, and then click the **View Session** button.

![Screenshot: Practice View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565376-02.jpg)

> NOTE: To return to the practice tab home screen from within a practice session, you must click the arrow button on the left of the screen. This will allow you to select a different practice session.

####

#### Sim Game

Sim Games function very similarly to a standard game. This session type is best for scrimmages and unconventional game situations. When viewing a Sim Game session, it will display in the Single Game format, with pitch locations, hit locations, event results, associated video, and any other data you have logged during the session. For a more detailed look into the Single Game format and all of its features, click here (see the “Single Game View” lesson).

![Screenshot: Practice View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565376-03.jpg)

####

#### Batting Practice

Select the batting practice session you would like to review, and above the tables, a list of the players who participated in that session will be displayed. Click the View Session button to view your recorded data.

![Screenshot: Practice View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565376-04.jpg)

To view the full batting practice session, click the **Play Full Game** icon in the center of the screen.

To view an individual pitch, you can click on the play icon on the right of the event.

![Screenshot: Practice View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565376-05.jpg)

Each group from the batting practice session will be displayed along the top right of the window. You can the events by group, by selecting the desired group button. By selecting a group, all of that groups events will display along the bottom of the window. You can deselect the group by clicking the group button a second time.

![Screenshot: Practice View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565376-06.jpg)

When a group is selected, the players within the group will be displayed below the group buttons. You can filter for each player by clicking on the players name beneath the group name, and this will display only the selected players events.

If you have have entered any hit location or other data, it will be reflected in the hit location chart, and the data table.

If you have only entered time stamps, and no data has been logged, the clips are still available for viewing, but the data fields will be listed as unknown. This can be a quick and easy way to simply cut up your batting practices for easier review by players and staff.

####

#### Bullpen

In the Bullpen table, all of your logged bullpen practices will be listed. There is a play icon next to each practice. Click the **Play** icon and it will play all of the video associated with the practice session. To view the associated data, select your session, and above the tables click the **View Session** button.

![Screenshot: Practice View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565376-07.jpg)

To view the a playlist of all pitches in the data table, click the **Play Full Game** button above the data table. To view the video of an individual pitch, click the **Play** icon next to the pitch you would like to watch.

![Screenshot: Practice View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565376-08.jpg)

A button for each of the pitchers from the bullpen session will be displayed in the upper right of the window. When a player is selected, all of the players pitches will be listed in the data table, and the pitch locations are shown on the display. When a pitch is selected in the data table, the intended pitch location will be highlighted on the display, as well as the pitch location itself.

![Screenshot: Practice View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565376-09.jpg)

In the video player, the video will display, if multiple angles were used, they will display side-by-side. To the right of the video player your pitch playlist will be display and you can navigate between the different clips. Above the playlist, you can click the **Field** icon, and this will display the data associated with the clip you are viewing, including Pitch Location, Pitch Type, Velocity, Pitch Delivery, Pitch Execution, and Intended Pitch Location.

![Screenshot: Practice View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565376-10.jpg)

The video player also has tools to play and pause the video, advance or reverse by one frame, skip clips back and forth, and advance and reverse the video. Above the navigation tools on the left, you can adjust the amount of pre-roll before the pitch using the dropdown menu.

![Screenshot: Practice View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565376-11.jpg)

You also have the ability to use the Compare (see the “Compare Video and Sending Clips” lesson) view by clicking Compare at the bottom right of the window. This allows you to compare two separate pitches side by side, or overlay video from two pitches by clicking the Overlay (see the “Compare Video and Sending Clips” lesson) button within the compare view. For a more in depth look at the compare view, check out the article here (see the “Compare Video and Sending Clips” lesson).

#### Training/Workout

The Training/Workout sessions are purely video files, with no data attached to them. This is meant to be a simple video repository, to allow for categorization of video files that can be easily accessed by members of your staff. When you select a Training/Workout session, all players and labels assigned to the session will display above the tables as a preview.

![Screenshot: Practice View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565376-12.jpg)

To view Training/Workout video, simply click the play icon next to the listed workout and the grouped clips will display in the video player.

![Screenshot: Practice View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565376-13.jpg)

You can view the players and labels associated by clicking the labels button in the top right of the video player.

![Screenshot: Practice View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565376-14.jpg)

## Multi-Practice View

Multi-Practice view allows you to consolidate and analyze data from multiple practice sessions simultaneously, providing a holistic understanding of player performance and development trends over time. Just like Multigame view enables comprehensive game analysis, Multi-Practice view empowers you to dive deep into your practice data.

####

#### **Key Enhancements for Practice Workflows**

The Multi-Practice view brings enhanced capabilities to your practice analysis. To access the Multi-Practice view, click the Multi-Practice icon in the upper right of the application.

![Screenshot: Multi-Practice View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591727-01.jpg)

#### **Search Across Multiple Sessions from Practice Workflows**

You can now seamlessly search and aggregate data from various practice types logged in Synergy Team Logger.

- **Sim Game**: Analyze performance and outcomes from simulated game scenarios.
- **Batting Practice**: Track hitter performance, contact quality, and progress during BP sessions.
- **Bullpen**: Evaluate pitcher mechanics, pitch usage, and execution during bullpen sessions.

#### **New Filters Specific to Practice Workflows**

To provide more granular insights, we've introduced several new filters designed specifically for practice data:

**Hitter(s)**: Filter by specific hitter(s) to analyze individual performance trends.

- **Swing Result**: Narrow your focus by the outcome of each swing, helping you identify patterns in contact, misses, and ball in play results.

![Screenshot: Multi-Practice View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591727-02.jpg)

**Practice(s):**Select all desired practices across which you would like to review data

![Screenshot: Multi-Practice View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591727-03.jpg)

**Practice Type**: Easily sort and view data from specific practice types.

![Screenshot: Multi-Practice View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591727-04.jpg)

**Pitch Zones**: Gain insights into pitch location and effectiveness with these dedicated filters:

- **Pitch Execution**: Analyze how well pitches were executed relative to their intended location.

![Screenshot: Multi-Practice View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591727-05.jpg)

**Intended Pitch Zone**: Filter by the planned target zone for each pitch, allowing for evaluation of strategic execution.

####

![Screenshot: Multi-Practice View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591727-06.jpg)

####
